evidence: Reviewed all 56 criteria (gates: render 1, constraints 1; functional 44; polish 5; visual 5 Likert) in the frozen task under .qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r13/task against workbook Quality Checks/Internal Quality Checks row 32 and skill references/quality-checks.md section 32 (defects: 'looks right', source read, response-shape assertion with no state change, probe leaving no trace). PASS observations: (1) Every functional/polish criterion names a concrete browser outcome with re-readable state: card stage/place re-read in Mei Lin's independent context (hro_add_candidate, hro_arrive_bottom, hro_reorder, hro_bulk_move, hro_undo_restores - functional/judge.toml:38,65,74,218,245); refusals are paired with a same-kind positive control and an 'unchanged' re-read (prompt.md:17,19 'Record before/after facts per row'; e.g. hro_interview_full:110, hro_bulk_all_or_none:227, hro_undo_conflict:254, hro_observer_readonly:173). (2) No criterion asks for source reading; prompt.md:1 forbids inspecting source/bundles/DB. (3) Status-code rows are not bare response-shape assertions: hro_refusal_status:200 counts only replays whose no-change refusal was established in their owning rows, and the 401/403/404/409 codes are public (environment/instructions/hireops_rules.md:21-23,77-78). hro_anonymous:191 pairs 401 with 'no workspace data; nothing changes' and signed-in controls. (4) Distinctive probes: review-suffixed job/card names (prompt.md:15,27), 'plain' literal (hro_msg_compose:317), seeded Platform Engineer order and Noor's exact note text (prompt.md:25, hro_restart:416), 'Call back on Fri' note draft (polish hro_pol_live_board:23), Tomas rejection reason searched in candidate responses (hro_candidate_private:398, prompt.md:43). (5) Time-varying outcomes have explicit windows and measurement methods: 15 s no-reload/no-click (hro_live_board:299, hro_unread_counts:344, hro_seen:362; prompt.md:41,47), document.activeElement and scroll offsets via page.evaluate (polish prompt.md:14; hro_refused_put_back:137; hro_pol_live_board:23), getBoundingClientRect within a few pixels (hro_pol_earlier_place:41), single-request abort/offline with resend-once (hro_pol_failed_send:50). (6) Durability: hro_restart:416 uses the verifier restart_app tool and compares jobs, order, notes, messages, unread, activity and seeded order/note; constraints gate (gates/constraints/judge.toml:23) requires independent-context readback and rejects static/no-op/browser-only saves. (7) Visual rows are shipped-format Likert with anchors over named surfaces (visual/judge.toml:24-90, visual prompt.md:14), which the skill treats as expected, not a 'looks right' binary. NOTES (not blocking on their own): (a) hro_add_candidate:38 'entered source is shown wherever the app shows card details' and hro_job_open:29 'team ... shown wherever the app shows job details' can be vacuous legs; acceptable because the public brief/rules (hireops_rules.md:27-32) require storing but not displaying source, and team is independently required on the candidate view (hro_candidate_view:389). (b) hro_refused_put_back:137 is decidable only when the UI lets the judge attempt the move into a full Interview; prompt.md:23 says whether a refused action is offered is the app's choice, so an app that hides the Interview option with no explanation yields no observable put-back and scores 0 on a weight-2 row. This is consistent with the policy that a mandatory feature needs observed evidence (hireops_rules.md:82-85 requires put-back, reason, focus), and the criterion explicitly accepts a pre-move UI refusal with reason and focus, so I record it as a residual probe-coverage note rather than a confirmed defect. The golden offers the option and reverts (solution/app/public/js/board.js:170,197,203,267). (c) hro_move_one_stage:56 'at the first look after the action' depends on Playwright MCP's post-click snapshot timing; public rule is 'appears on the mover's board immediately' (hireops_rules.md:84), so a poll-only app is meant to fail; minor timing sensitivity, not a one-second distinction between conforming behaviours. WEAK/CONFORMING-ALTERNATIVE TRIALS: A dead app returning static JSON or browser-only saves fails the constraints gate and the functional/polish gate (prompt.md:11). An app that hides refused controls still earns credit where 'hiding it is optional' is stated (hro_move_one_stage, hro_reject_hired, hro_mgr_other_job) because server refusal is checked by replay; exception noted in (b). An app with any route/field names passes since prompts forbid route assumptions (prompt.md:15,17; app_context.md:33-34). RISK: No configured full judge run exists. raw-evidence-index.json scope states 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent'; its workspace.json hash (47c2e8ef...f38) matches the file on disk but it is a scripted golden driver, not evidence that the claude-code judge can actually decide all 44 functional criteria within its 9000 s budget across protocols Z-D. Practical browser decidability of this very long protocol is therefore unmeasured, so risk=true.
suggested_fix: Optional hardening: in hro_refused_put_back, if the UI does not offer the move into a full Interview, accept a visible explanation on that card (or prescribe making the board stale, e.g. Mei fills Interview just before Rafael's attempt) so a UI-hiding app's put-back is observable; and obtain a full configured judge run to measure decidability within budget.
